articles.title: A Class 10 student from Kerala builds a remote-controlled farm machine that could make farmers' lives easier, wins science award
articles.summary: Anax Joshi, a Class 10 student from St Mary's High School in Kerala's Idukki district, has won the Bala Shastra Puraskaram for designing a remote-controlled multipurpose agricultural vehicle. His innovation aims to reduce farmers' physical workload and the cost of purchasing separate machines for different farming operations.
